hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: A right triangle is uniquely determined by its 90-degree corner vertex and two other endpoints in the same row and column.

hints.title: Vertex Multiplicity
hints.text: Precompute the total count of ones in each row and in each column.

hints.title: Product Sum
hints.text: For each cell with a value of one, it can act as the vertex of (row_ones - 1) * (col_ones - 1) right triangles. Sum this product across all ones in the grid.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Two linear scans over the matrix.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all triplets of cells takes O((m*n)^3) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(m + n) space for row and column sum arrays.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that corner vertices decompose the counting independently across rows and columns.
